text:
Jordan: following up on postmortem items for missing spans, aggregation drift, and ETL backlogs. want a single tracker + owners and clear rollback/gating. who can take ownership of the tracker?
Alex: I will run the tracker and keep cards updated. propose swimlanes: spans / aggregation / etl. will add links to PRs and monitoring dashboards.
Priya: taking missing spans. plan: tighten schema validation, add defensive guards in the instrumentation layer, and emit spans.schema.fail_count. prefer user-hash canary 5%->25%->100%. estimated 4 business days to staged canary.
Matt: I'll own aggregation correctness (dedupe and window alignment). saw a recurring reducer issue in logs: 
```
2026-03-19T14:03:11Z aggregator ERROR merge-mismatch id=9f3c2a expected_keys=4 got=2
```
I'll add a 30-day historical-compare CI job that fails if daily_aggregate_diff > 0.5%. estimate 7-10 days.
Samira: ETL lag RCA: recurring pattern when large backup jobs overlap with nightly batch windows -> queue buildup. short-term: stagger start-times and add alert on etl.queue_backlog > 60% for 10m. long-term: token-bucket backpressure with visible queue_accept_rate metric. I'll push the stagger tonight (low risk).
Liam: I'll help instrument the aggregator to emit queue_accept_rate and per-window accept counts so infra can use them for the token-bucket work.
oncall-bot: Incident 1849123456 STATUS changed to RESOLVED by oncall-bot.
Jordan: good. Alex please ensure each tracker card contains: owner, PR link, canary steps, regression CI job, rollback criteria, and a short recurrence-note linking past incidents. rollback criteria suggestion: error_rate increase > 0.5% OR p99 latency > 2x baseline OR daily_aggregate_delta > 1.0%.
Alex: will add those. board URL when ready: https://redwood.internal/boards/obs-remediations-2 (internal).
Priya: question on telemetry for canary: should we sample full traces for 1% of canary traffic and forward to observability-sample? I want to capture end-to-end traces to validate span continuity.
Jordan: yes - capture sampled traces and compare span_drop_count between canary and control every 15m.
Matt: adding regression checks: unit tests for merge keys + the historical-compare job. I'll also produce a short doc describing expected invariants for the aggregator (dedupe rules, window boundaries) so future rollouts have a checklist.
Samira: pushed staggers to prod (low-risk). set alert: etl.queue_backlog > 60% for 10m -> page SRE. also created INFRA-789 for token-bucket design.
Liam: aggregated metric hooks added to a dev branch; will open PR and tag Matt/Samira for review. includes queue_accept_rate and window_accept_count.
Alex: tracker cards created and owners assigned. adding weekly 15-min check-ins and daily status updates for canary periods.
Jordan: action recap from this thread ->
- Alex: create + own tracker/board, link PRs/dashboards, run check-ins
- Priya: spans schema + canary + sampling (target 2026-04-01)
- Matt: aggregation fixes + regression CI job + invariants doc (target 2026-04-07)
- Samira: ETL stagger deployed (done), token-bucket design ticket INFRA-789 (target 2026-04-12)
- Liam: aggregator metric hooks PR (in review)
We'll do a 15-min sync Friday to confirm statuses. if any card slips, tag me and escalate. :thumbsup:
